notes.source: Olympus__Pack_Ops_v0.4.md — canonical Ops vocabulary (sheet retired). Transcribed verbatim from §B/§C; do not invent entries.
notes.packMode: vocab-only: this pack carries VOCABULARY and SCHEMA only. All behavior lives in Olympus__M0_Intent_v2.md, published separately as a versioned behavior spec (never hard-coded). The app composes behavior spec + pack §B/§C as the structuring prompt.
notes.flagLayers: Ruling C6 (2026-08-05): two layers govern. claimFlags = Pack §B8, closed list, applied to individual claim lines (the only flags the AI may output). cardFlags = the BR-1/BR-4/FR-15 system set, applied by the SERVER at card/system level (STALE at presentation, THIN-POOL at nomination, NOT-TRIGGERED at reading) — never by the AI.
notes.zeroStates: "Not Yet" (execution score 0) is transcribed in scores but deliberately absent from the claimable execution enum: silence and ownership-less mentions map to NOT-CLAIMED, never to a zero-state (Invariant 7; same ruling as v0.2/v0.3 transcriptions).

execution: My work is being checked by someone else
I fully own the work — no one checks behind me
I own the work but delegates it to someone else
decision: I executed the decision given to me
I made the decision, but someone above me could overturn it
The decision is fully rest on me and no one else

claimFlags: did not make the call — doesn't lift level
